verdict.rationale: Dropbox’s DBX Platform documents a broad Files API (create, read, edit, move, delete), webhooks, OAuth scopes, and team namespace listing, giving strong API parity for core storage/sharing actions comparable to the UI. However, newer UI-surfaced features like Dash AI search/summarization and PDF editing/signature workflows are only described as end-user products, not confirmed as programmatically accessible via the same API, and no OpenAPI spec was found (404s) to verify full endpoint coverage. Missing for 10: documented API parity for Dash AI features, PDF editing, and a public OpenAPI spec confirming exhaustive endpoint coverage.
